server.article-tools.name: Article tools
server.article-tools.description: Create or delete articles, manage pins and tags.
server.assistant-memory-tools.name: Personal assistant memory
server.assistant-memory-tools.descriptio: Understand recent activity, long-term context, and relevant experiences. Memories are maintained in the background with their sources.
server.card-tools.name: Card tools
server.card-tools.description: Create or delete cards, manage pins and tags.
server.content-edit-tools.name: Content editing tools
server.content-edit-tools.description: Rewrite content, locate ranges, edit in batches, and create drafts.
server.content-link-tools.name: Content linking tools
server.content-link-tools.description: Add or remove explicit bidirectional links between content.
server.context-tools.name: App context tools
server.context-tools.description: Inspect the current page, focused editor, selected text and block, open detail views such as tasks and events, and app version.
server.data-table-tools.name: Read-only table tools
server.data-table-tools.description: List and read tables in the current library, including database entries and embedded project tables. Convert cells to plain text using their field definitions and return Markdown tables without modifying data. Prefer these tools over querying JSON columns in data_tables directly.
server.project-document-tools.name: Project document tools
server.project-document-tools.descriptio: Create, link, remove, and move documents in project folders.
server.fetch-tools.name: Network request tools
server.filesystem-tools.name: Image reading tools
server.filesystem-tools.description: Read images from remote URLs or data:image for AI visual analysis, including checking generated images. Local images and text files use the AI assistant’s built-in read tool.
server.openai-image-tools.name: Image generation tools
server.sql-query-tools.name: Read-only SQL tools
server.sql-query-tools.description: Query structured data in the current main database. Only a single read-only SELECT, WITH, EXPLAIN, or restricted schema PRAGMA is allowed. Read the database-schema Skill before use.
server.task-assistant-tools.name: Task and event assistant
server.task-assistant-tools.description: Query and update standalone, recurring, and content-based tasks and events, with revision checks, batch receipts, and undo.
scope.pdf.name: PDF documents
scope.pdf.description: In PDF chats, AI can search the document, read pages, and inspect its outline, annotations, and bookmarks.
scope.video.name: Video notes
scope.video.description: In video note chats, AI can search transcripts and read passages by time range.
scope.learning.name: Learning projects
scope.learning.description: In learning project (Notebook) chats, AI can search project sources, generate learning material, and save it as notes.
pi.name: Core AI tools
pi.description: File reading, editing, and command execution tools included with the AI assistant, available by default in every chat.
pi.read: Read local text or image files, with offset / limit for partial reads.
pi.edit: Edit local files using exact oldText / newText pairs, with multiple non-overlapping changes in one operation.
pi.write: Create or replace a local file.
pi.bash: Run shell commands (PowerShell on Windows), with an optional timeout.
subagent.name: Subagents
subagent.description: Create, reuse, wait for, and cancel subagents. send_parent is available only to child sessions for reporting progress.
availability.image: Configure an image generation service first
